prompt: A photorealistic, ancient sentinel wyvern perches securely on the user's outer shoulder. Its body features PBR anisotropic obsidian scales with liquid mercury glints, porous basalt claws, and subtle 24k gold accents on its horns, with subsurface scattering on its leathery wings. Lit by 3-point contrast lighting (key, 6500K/2800K rim) with ray-traced contact shadows. Opening mouth triggers a powerful volumetric emerald breath weapon. Smiling creates a soft golden bloom.
visual_hook: A photorealistic, ancient wyvern instantly appears, perched with striking PBR materials and dramatic lighting.

prompt: User's full-body movement activates two iridescent, translucent holographic clones, dancing in synchronized motion. Clones feature subsurface scattering for an ethereal glow. Audio-reactive liquid mercury laser rings pulse from the floor, casting ray-traced contact shadows. Background evolves into an anisotropic metal club visualizer with subtle 24k gold accents. Lighting: 3-point contrast, key light, 6500K/2800K rim lights. Head tilt projects a glowing audio waveform.
visual_hook: Instantaneous appearance of dancing holographic clones mirroring the user's movement, surrounded by pulsing laser rings.

prompt: Fitted mythic 3D dragon horn headpiece anchored strictly to head, crafted from anisotropic obsidian scales and liquid 24k gold filigree. 3-point contrast lighting with warm key light, cool 6500K rim light, and ray-traced contact shadows. Opening mouth triggers flowing emerald flame particles and rising embers. Smiling activates bright golden runic eye flares. PBR materials, no strobing, ultra-realistic.
visual_hook: Instant appearance of gleaming obsidian and gold dragon horns fitted to the user's head with hyper-realistic reflections.
